engine: gapsystudio's HOME camera-dolly — the homepage is one continuous 3D walk through a virtual studio, scroll = camera moving deeper into the room. This is the NO-WebGL APPROXIMATION: a pinned scroll-scrub drives a MULTI-LAYER PARALLAX that fakes a forward dolly — each layer carries a data-depth (0 far .. 1 near); on scroll the near layers GROW (scale) + rush past faster while far layers barely move, so the viewer reads as flying INTO the scene. A focal 'wall' headline arrives as the camera gets there. Harvested from D_gapsy (A home studio-tour; basket B — fake-3D, built LAST).
honesty: NO-WebGL APPROXIMATION of a live-3D scene. The gapsy original is a real WebGL 3D room + camera — we do NOT copy that. This is a layered-parallax ILLUSION of a forward dolly (depth-keyed scale + drift), NOT a 3D scene with real geometry/camera. HIGHER-FIDELITY PATH: feed a PRE-RENDERED fly-through frame sequence into the sibling `scroll-scrub-video` brick (frames -> canvas + ImageBitmap) instead of CSS layers — that gives a true rendered dolly without WebGL at runtime.

measured_teardown.move: one pinned scroll-scrub, progress p 0..1. Each [data-depth=d] layer: scale = 1 + p*dollyGain*d (near grows most, far barely), translate3d Y = p*driftY*(d-0.5)*2 (near rushes one way, far drifts the other) -> the differential reads as forward camera motion. The nearest layers (d>0.75) fade out as they pass the camera near the end (p>0.78). The focal [data-arrive] block reveals opacity + translateY 30->0 + scale 0.96->1 over [arriveAt .. 1], power3.out. transform: translate3d + scale only (GPU).
measured_teardown.cited: gapsy home: scroll dollies the camera through rooms (hero-wall 3D letters -> showreel-room -> portfolio-room -> ping-pong room); the foreground geometry sweeps past as the camera advances and each wall's headline arrives in turn.

dollyGain.what: how much the NEAR layers grow over the travel (scale at p=1 for d=1 is 1+dollyGain). Higher = stronger rush-forward.

driftY.what: vertical drift spread between far and near layers (the parallax separation).

arriveAt.what: progress at which the focal headline starts arriving (reveal over [arriveAt..1]).

pinFactor.what: length of the pinned scroll span = the dolly travel time.

ease.what: scrub ease (linear by default so the dolly tracks scroll 1:1; the arrive block has its own power3.out).

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; set false when the page drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: RoomDollyScroll.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), refresh(), destroy }. target = .rds-stage > .rds-layer[data-depth] x N (far..near) + an optional [data-arrive] focal block. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the dolly.
law: transform: scale + translate3d + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend over the layers; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> arrived state (focal shown), no pin. owns_pin TRUE. The 'depth' is authored per-layer (data-depth), not computed from a 3D scene — it's a parallax illusion. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) standalone.
gate_mode: owns_pin scroll-scrub. Verify the DEPTH DIFFERENTIAL (near layer scale >> far layer scale at the same p) + the arrive-reveal window + fps/jank. GATE-BLINDSPOT: a single static screenshot reads as a plain zoom — check the per-layer scale spread (far vs near) to confirm the parallax. Drive the LAB's own pinned instance to screenshot.
proven: lab: 4 full-bleed QUADRO layers (day-front far d0.1 / terrace mid d0.5 / aerial floor d0.7 / macro-pergola near d0.9) + a focal red 3D-text headline. Curve measured live (p / far-scale / mid / near / arrive-op): 0 / 1.000 / 1.000 / 1.000 / 0 -> 0.30 / 1.048 / 1.240 / 1.432 / 0 -> 0.55 / 1.088 / 1.440 / 1.792 / 0 -> 0.80 / 1.128 / 1.640 / 2.152 / 0.91 -> 1 / 1.160 / 1.800 / 2.440 / 1. Near grows 2.44x vs far 1.16x = the dolly differential; arrive headline reveals after 0.55. Mid-dolly frame: the foreground pergola layer (scale 1.6) sweeping past the camera; arrived frame: 'FROM COOL IDEA INSANELY GREAT' red extruded-style headline on the dollied-in scene (matches gapsy hero-wall arrival). Probe (4x CPU throttle, 4 full-bleed layers scaling): 1/789 long frames (0.1%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
